title: Retail Apparel Turnaround
background: An apparel retailer has falling sales, excess inventory, and declining customer relevance.
candidate_prompt: How would you evaluate the situation and recommend what the organization should do next?
good_answer_includes: Diagnoses the root causes of underperformance
Separates revenue, cost, operational, and market issues
Identifies urgent cash and performance levers
great_answer_includes: Distinguishes temporary issues from structural decline
Considers stakeholder constraints and execution capacity
Balances quick wins with longer-term repositioning
interviewer_notes: A strong candidate should use a clear turnaround structure, isolate the most important drivers, and connect the recommendation to business impact.
